create_translation_parameters: create TranslationParameters with source and target language settings for inference
build_translation_input: build TranslationInput with text string and optional parameters for translation inference
parse_translation_output: parse TranslationOutput to extract the translated text from inference results
configure_translation_truncation: configure TranslationTruncationStrategy to control how long texts are truncated during translation
validate_translation_types: validate TranslationInput and TranslationOutput dataclasses against the inference schema
